facts.business: ICRA Limited is a credit rating agency that provides ratings, research, analytics, and ESG ratings, operating as a knowledge partner and risk navigator for financial markets.

guidance_or_targets.statement: ICRA pegs the WPI at ~6.6% and the CPI at ~4.7% in FY2027, with risks tilted to the upside. ICRA expects an extended pause on the policy rates in the near term, followed by back-ended rate hikes towards the end of the fiscal, amid the anticipated slowdown in GDP growth.

key_risks: Geopolitical headwinds including tariff-related uncertainty and West Asia conflict impacting energy prices and corporate profitability
Disruption to shipping and commodity prices affecting merchandise exports and private capex
Fiscal slippages due to GST rationalisation leading to hardening of bond yields
Consistent foreign outflows and tight liquidity conditions
Slowdown in GDP growth anticipated in FY2027
Accelerating adoption of automation and Generative AI reshaping client requirements
facts.related_party_note: Revenue from one customer group of the Group's segment is ₹15,454.94 lakhs (previous year ₹15,049.38 lakhs) which is more than 10 percent of the Group's total revenue.
